claim: Replaces the previous "reasonable price" arbitration standard with a strict statutory cap: the buyout amount cannot be greater than the practitioner's total annual salary and wages at the time of termination
evidence: The covenant must allow the physician to buyout of the covenant for an amount not greater than the physician’s total annual salary and wages at the time the contract or employment is terminated.
excerpt:
Buyout capThe covenant must allow the physician to buyout of the covenant for an amount not greater than the physician’s total annual salary and wages at the time the contract or employment is terminated.

Time limitationThe covenant must expire no later than one year after the date the contract or employment was terminated.
